def can_construct_city(L, R):
    if R - L + 1 > 31:
        return "NO"
    
    n = R - L + 2
    m = n - 1
    
    roads = []
    for i in range(1, n):
        roads.append((i, i + 1, L + i - 1))
    
    return f"YES\n{n} {m}\n" + "\n".join(f"{a} {b} {c}" for a, b, c in roads)
